notes: Frontend is internal-only POV UI for historical-ticket-based support workflows.
API contract is authoritative; no queue-list endpoint, no ticket list endpoint, no auth flow, no raw-text triage generation endpoint, and no raw-text similar-ticket search endpoint are designed here.

Because the API exposes ticket detail by ticket number only, the agent workflow requires a ticket-number-driven entry pattern (for example deep link or direct lookup input) rather than a browsable queue.
Because the API only returns stored triage guidance and stored similar tickets on ticket detail, the UI can display guidance but cannot trigger generation/regeneration from the browser.
Because similar-ticket search requires a query embedding and no embedding-generation endpoint exists, ad hoc similar-ticket search from raw text is not included as a user-facing screen.

pages.purpose: Primary agent workflow screen showing ticket details, stored triage guidance, and 3-4 similar resolved historical tickets with resolution summaries. Also supports status updates such as marking in progress or resolved.

data_requirements.name: ticket core details
data_requirements.description: Ticket number, source channel, subject, description, account tier, product line, status, created_at, manual_priority.

data_requirements.name: triage suggestion
data_requirements.description: Suggested priority, confidence, generated_at, model_version, suggested team details; may be null/unavailable.

data_requirements.name: similar resolved tickets
data_requirements.description: 3-4 similar tickets including subject, description, product line, manual priority, resolution category, and resolution summary.

data_requirements.name: support teams
data_requirements.description: Optional reference data used to validate or populate assigned team selection when updating status with assigned_team_id.

Optional lightweight refresh of triage panel only, if UI offers manual panel refresh without reloading the whole page.
